title: Transfer stablecoins and stocks
summary: Transfer USDC, SOL, and supported stock tokens to another Solana wallet. Review the recipient, amount, and fees before you approve. Local preview shown with sample balances.

items.title: Transfer without leaving your page
items.description: Open Transfer from your account menu, choose USDC, SOL, or a stock token, and enter the receiving Solana wallet.

items.title: Your stock tokens can move too
items.description: Send unlocked stock tokens you hold, including fractional shares. Oren keeps the exact token variant and handles xStocks share adjustments.

items.title: Review the full transfer
items.description: Check the receiving address, quantity, network fee, and any receiving token-account cost before approving.

items.title: Keep track of pending transfers
items.description: Reopen a pending transfer to check its status. If submission needs another attempt, Oren retries the same signed transfer.

screenshots.alt: Full landscape view of Oren with the transfer modal open, Tesla logos in the asset and amount controls, and empty receiving-wallet and amount fields. Local preview with sample balances.
